items.q: Petrillo. Said, "Bring your instruments and things up there, you know."

ctx.x: Petrillo. Said, "Bring your instruments and things up there, you know." And we walked right on by Smith and went on upstairs, and we played, oh, two or three or four numbers while we were up there, you know. It was about 10:00 o'clock, you know, so I guess we must have sat around and had a few drinks, playing socializing, and it's about 11:00 now. The place was packed. So he said, "Now, you all can go home. You don't have to go on the stand no more tonight. You can go home." And says, "There'll be a bottle of…

you're dogging him, you know? Even I couldn't say nothing. I used to call him names. He'd get up on the stand and he'd make you mad. Here we are on the bandstand at 6:00 o'clock. We were supposed to play from 6:00 to 7:00 for the dinner hour, and come back from 9:00 to 1:00. Now, it happens that a certain night in the week, when you go on at 6:00 o'clock, you're on the air, too, NBC, coast to coast. Now, we get in there and get ready to hit, and everybody'd say, "Where's Stuff and John," [Brown] the bass player,…
